criteria_location: Clinical Indications, pp. 2-6 of 9: ALL-of list with procedure choice (partial / total / revision), a documentation block, then two NOT COVERED lists. Notes in Background (no timeframe; surgeon must optimize comorbidities).

logic.top_level: all (ALL of: one procedure + its clinical indication; AND documentation block), then NOT-covered exclusion lists

k_of_n.quote: Radiographic or arthroscopic findings of 1 or more of the following: Severe ... degenerative arthritis; Avascular necrosis (AVN)
a combination of strategies to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and improve function, including 2 or more of the following
1 or more of the following: The member's BMI is less than 40 and/or they have no medical comorbidities; For members with BMI > 40 ...; significant conditions ...; diabetes ...
non-surgical medical management may be inappropriate, ineffective, or counterproductive as evidenced by 1 or more of the following: Bone on bone articulation; Severe deformity; Severe pain

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Two separate lists headed 'NOT COVERED for Any of the following' (UKA: 13 items; TKA: 8 items), written after the criteria.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Revision is a third procedure under the ALL list with 10 any-of indications (loosening, fracture, infection, periprosthetic bone loss, wear with synovitis, misalignment, stiffness/arthrofibrosis, instability). No repeat or bilateral rule.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Documentation in the medical record of 1 or more of the following: When any procedure above is indicated for advanced joint disease, ALL of the following: ... That non-surgical medical management may be inappropriate ... For TKA indications other than advanced joint disease, ALL of the following when indicated
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The 1-or-more documentation block is an OR of three differently shaped branches; 'when indicated' is not defined. The 'non-surgical management may be inappropriate' branch reads as a separate alternative to the 3-month history, but sits at the same level as the branch that contains the history.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The member's BMI is less than 40 and/or they have no medical comorbidities
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or' makes the first sub-bullet satisfied by BMI < 40 alone, by no comorbidities alone, or both.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: For members with BMI > 40, at least six (6) months of provider-directed non-surgical management has failed. Provider-directed non-surgical management may be inappropriate. The medical record must clearly document why
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A sentence list of alternatives without OR; BMI exactly 40 unaddressed (< 40 above, > 40 here).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Adherence to a tobacco-cessation program resulting in abstinence from tobacco for at least 6 weeks prior to surgery is recommended. If smoking cessation is not achieved, then the provider must document they reviewed the benefits
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'recommended' means this is a soft requirement; the actual requirement is documentation of counseling.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: poor control as evidenced by an elevated HbA1c levels (> 8.5%), every effort was made to optimize
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Threshold only defines when optimization must be documented, not a coverage cutoff.

extraction_hazards: Checkbox glyphs in the header (☐ ☒) carry the applicability facts; plain text extraction shows both boxes similarly, so selected vs unselected must be read from the glyph.
Bullets and nesting levels use private glyphs, only indentation shows depth (up to 5 levels).
'Restricted Page |n' footers break the list in mid-branch (pages 2/3/4/5/6).
Fractions rendered as 1/4 mile; degree signs dropped in places ('greater than 90' then degree glyph).
NOT COVERED lists are physically after the criteria and before pre-auth, easily mistaken for part of the BMI block.
Text 'Effective Date 9/1/2021' while references are 'Accessed August 12, 2026': revision dates not printed.
interesting_structures: Top-level 'ALL of' contains an 'at least one procedure' choice and a documentation clause; a procedure-specific indication is nested under each procedure.
Requirement is partly a documentation requirement ('documentation must establish') rather than a clinical fact.
Six-month recency of clinical visit with surgeon attestation fallback.
BMI > 40 raises conservative therapy from 3 to 6 months.
Comorbidity and A1c criteria are phrased as 'document risk/benefit discussion', never as a numeric cutoff.
Quantified walking distance in function criterion (1/4 mile / two city blocks).

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = clean, 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Logic is expressible, but many leaves are documentation-quality tests ('documentation includes start and end dates', attestation), conditional blocks (BMI branch) and open-ended NOT lists with soft words ('significantly', 'cannot be optimally managed').
